stinkbeard_delirium.//: Story Phase 13 (chapter 139 on): the captain breathed through his beard once too often and now sees the Ancient Grand Stenchmasters of Garrick's legends in his crew. A presentation layer only: the dialogue box shows the alias's name and portrait, flickering now and then to the real ones; the world draws the alias's look, with a ghost of it now and then. Ids, saves, quests and dialogue all stay the real crew's. Pete is Pete. Brogath is not confirmed.
